ledger.x: 82 BC: Burebista founds the Dacian kingdom.
about 55 BC: Burebista annexes the Greek cities of the Black Sea coast.
ledger.cp: West Pontic Greek cities (Olbia to Apollonia)

ledger.x: 44 BC: Burebista is killed and the kingdom falls apart.

wars.name: Burebista's conquest of the Boii and Taurisci
wars.outcome: 'In 60/59 BC he defeated and conquered the Boii', along with the Taurisci (Burebista page).

wars.name: Burebista and the Roman civil war
wars.outcome: 'During the Roman civil war of 49-44 BC' Pompey gained Burebista's support through Akornion; Caesar 'ended that alliance at Pharsalus and planned an attack, but was assassinated in 44 BC before it began' (Burebista page).

certainty.note: The pages give rivers (Danube, Tisza, Dniester) and the Black Sea as limits; no frontier is surveyed.
